pkgmetadata.longdescription: oikb syncs content from various sources (S3, GCS, Azure Blob, Dropbox, Google Drive, local files, web pages, SharePoint) into Open WebUI Knowledge Bases, with support for scheduled and event-driven sync.

use.flag: Sync from Google Drive, Gmail, and Google Sites
Sync from Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Object Storage
Sync from AWS S3 and Cloudflare R2
Sync from web pages via HTML scraping
